output_dependence_findings.finding: THE RECEIPT'S ASSERTED NUMBER IS NEVER COMPARED TO THE LEG'S OUTPUT. demanded_outputs binds a receipt leaf to a leg output position by KEY NAME (exact_key / engine_prefix_key) and stores the receipt value as d['value']; nothing downstream reads it. Movement is measured between d['baseline'] (the LEG's value) and the severed run. So an honest leg discharges any number the receipt cares to assert under a matching key.
output_dependence_findings.measured: receipt asserts 42.0 and 99.0; the byte-identical-behaviour honest leg computes 1.1753902435302734 and 5.25; verdict DEPENDENT, exit 0, reason 'every asserted number moved'.
output_dependence_findings.why_it_matters: The file's own docstring states a DEPENDENT verdict 'excludes b10-shaped and b4/b5-shaped fabrication'. b4/b5 is asserted-value-diverges-from-computed-value, and it is not excluded. The sibling module built in the same round DOES make this comparison and refuses the same shape (case y9, exit 1), so the missing check is one comparison that already exists 200 lines away in the same package.

output_dependence_findings.finding: THE HARNESS SHIPS ITS SEVERANCE PLAN INTO THE PROCESS UNDER TEST. run_severed passes OD_MODE, OD_FACTOR, OD_OFFSET, OD_TARGET and OD_LEG in the environment, and the harness executes the leg with runpy.run_path in the same process without clearing os.environ. Directly measured: a leg reads {OD_MODE: NULL|ENTRY|ZERO, OD_FACTOR: 1.37|0.0, OD_OFFSET: 0.11|0.0, OD_TARGET: -1, OD_LEG: <its own path>}.
output_dependence_findings.measured: one jnp.zeros call with the result discarded (fixture b10's shape), two hand-typed constants, print them unchanged when OD_MODE is NULL and multiply by OD_FACTOR plus OD_OFFSET otherwise. S0 neutrality holds; ENTRY, ALL and ZERO all move; exit 0.

output_dependence_findings.finding: THE PERTURBATION IS RECONSTRUCTABLE FROM THE ENGINE'S OWN RETURNS, WITH NO ENVIRONMENT READ AND NOTHING TO GREP. jnp.zeros returns OFFSET when severed and jnp.ones returns FACTOR+OFFSET, so two entry calls with known honest values recover the affine map exactly. The leg then applies it to hand-typed constants, so every asserted number moves by precisely the amount an honest value would have moved. ZERO is distinguishable too (ones -> 0.0), so no refuting stage can measure invariance.
output_dependence_findings.why_it_matters: F7's closure is stated as 'there is no string to grep for'. That is true and it is not the property that mattered: a severance is detectable by its own effect. This case survives closing L2, so the leak and the class are two separate defects and fixing the environment does not fix this.

output_dependence_findings.finding: A CRASH CREDITS NOTHING BUT IT DESTROYS THE REFUTING EVIDENCE, AND THE LEG CHOOSES WHICH STAGE MAY SPEAK. S1 ENTRY, S2 ALL and S3 ZERO each perturb every entry position at once, so one guard on one entry position kills all three. S4 SINGLE then perturbs one call at a time and is existential-only by design: it can establish dependence and can never refute it. A leg that survives exactly that stage reaches exit 0 with no computation.
output_dependence_findings.measured: stage exit codes ENTRY 70, ALL 70, ZERO 70, SINGLE[0] 70, SINGLE[1] 0; both demanded values moved_under ['SINGLE[1]'], verdict DEPENDENT, exit 0. The leg is two jnp.ones calls, a guard, and two hand-typed constants multiplied by a value read back out of the engine.

SINGLE_CAP=32, and the builder measured 1435 outermost calls on the real ratchet_contract leg with the first 32 being library registration calls, so a carrier past index 31 would not fire. output_dependence_findings.finding: ANY SCALE-AND-SHIFT-STABLE OBSERVABLE IS REFUSED, INCLUDING WHEN JAX GENUINELY COMPUTES IT. The refuting severances perturb data affinely, so a signature, a rank, a count, a dimension or a normalised trace cannot move. Measured on an honest leg whose two numbers are jnp.sum(ev > 0) and jnp.linalg.matrix_rank(H): both INVARIANT under ENTRY and ALL, exit 1.
output_dependence_findings.why_it_matters: These are ordinary constraint-geometry observables — the rank of a distinguishability matrix and a spectral signature are exactly what this estate computes. This is finding F11's direction: a control that refuses honest computation trains people around the gate. Distinct from the builder's recorded theta0 gap, which is an input echo; these are genuine engine outputs.

julia_witness_findings.finding: A FIFTH RELIEVING SURFACE, BY PATH. demanded_from_receipt reads engines_ran.julia and nothing else. Its own _numeric_leaves walks every leaf at every depth; it is simply never applied to the receipt. Measured on a 7-numeric-leaf receipt: 2 leaves demanded, 5 ignored — three_engine_legs.julia.julia_berry_curvature and .julia_chern_number (julia claims by their own keys), agreement.julia_vs_jax_delta = 2.2e-15 (the exact s3/s6 payload that defeated design 4), floor_claims[0].value = 1.9999999999, and julia_input_contract.params.coupling.
julia_witness_findings.why_it_matters: The recorded lesson is that a NAME, a PATH, a TYPE and a BOUND are the same kind of thing. The module calls this 'a POSITIVE selection of what must be witnessed, not a negative list of what is excused', which is a true description of the intent and does not change the effect: numbers outside one path are presumed not to be julia claims. receipt_supplied_tolerance_fields_ignored was measured EMPTY on this receipt while 2.2e-15 rode through, because the key is julia_vs_jax_delta and the tolerance regex does not match it. Worse, the estate's real receipt puts engine numbers at three_engine_legs.julia (per output_dependence's own measured note on ratchet_contract/ratchetings/results/bures_to_fubini_study.json), so the selected path misses the shape the estate actually writes.

julia_witness_findings.finding: CONSTANT LAUNDERING THROUGH THE INPUT CONTRACT. F5b was closed by making source ablation refusal-only and input perturbation the only crediting family, on the stated ground that the verifier chooses the value at run time and 'a constant cannot track it'. The producer also writes the input contract: params come from receipt.julia_input_contract.params. So it divides by the baseline it declared — gap = c * 2 * (coupling / 0.5) — and the constant tracks.
julia_witness_findings.measured: no matrix, no eigenvalue, no package, no computation; both demanded values credited under input perturbation, transcription missed both, severing NO_PACKAGE_DECLARED, exit 0.

julia_witness_findings.finding: THE 'RUN-TIME CHOSEN' VALUE IS PREDICTABLE FROM THE PRODUCER'S OWN RECEIPT. input_perturbations computes nv = float(v) * 1.37 + 0.11, where 1.37 and 0.11 are constants in the verifier's source and v is the producer-written declared baseline. A producer that declares coupling 0.5 knows the verifier will send 0.795 before the leg is hashed. Only the nonce is unpredictable, and no demanded number is ever required to depend on the nonce.
julia_witness_findings.measured: a leg with NO arithmetic path from input to output at all — a two-entry lookup, `if a > 0.6 then (1.9, 3.1) else (c1*2, c2*2)` — measures exit 0 WITNESSED. This defeats the crediting control's stated ground directly, not by analogy.

cross_module_structural_finding.statement: The two modules built in the same round disagree on both of the two checks that decide the recorded error class, and neither has both. output_dependence has NO path relieving surface (x8, exit 3) and NO receipt-value comparison (x1, exit 0). julia_witness HAS a receipt-value comparison (y9, exit 1) and HAS a path relieving surface (y6, exit 0). Each module's open defect is closed in the other module, in the same package, in the same commit.
cross_module_structural_finding.what_it_implies: Merging the two checks would refuse x1, y6 and y9. It would NOT close x2, x3, y1 or y10, because fake movement and laundered tracking touch neither check. Severance and perturbation bound what a fabricating leg can look like; they do not establish that the declared operation ran. Both modules say so in their own ceilings, and this deck measures the cost of that ceiling as four unearned passes each.
